stem: The two cranes on the eastern quay, which failed their annual safety inspection in March, must stay parked with their booms lowered ______ the end of next month, when the contractor expects to finish replacing the brake assemblies.

A passenger whose checked bag was damaged on a flight must lodge a written claim at the airline's baggage office ______ seven days, excluding public holidays, of receiving it, or the carrier may reject the claim.
The finance department reconciles the corporate card statements ______ the end of every month, never earlier, because late transactions continue to be posted until midnight on the last day.
Pumps 3 and 4 at the Orsden water plant ran without a recorded fault ______ the first six months of the year, a record that ended only when a clogged intake screen stopped Pump 3 in July.

The January forecast for the Corvan folding tablet assumed that sales would be slow, yet orders have so far run ______ the forecast, and the factory has had to add a second shift to keep up with them.
Each technician must log the serial number of every replacement part ______ installing it, so that the number can be checked against the approved parts list while the part is still in its packaging.
The refinery has trimmed its weekly output ______ the outage at Harbor Point that began last week, rather than waiting for the regulator to order a cut.

The 12-inch valve fittings that the crew ordered on the third have been ______ stock at the Harlow warehouse ever since a strike halted production, so the supervisor has asked the Bexley depot to fill the order.

Under the revised travel rules, mileage claims filed ______ the first of next month will be reimbursed at the new rate of sixty cents per mile, whereas claims filed earlier will still be paid at the old rate.
The operating permit for the Calder Street plant has been suspended ______ the outcome of the safety review, which the inspector says he cannot complete before the end of March.
The new wayfinding signs have been installed ______ the terminal, from the check-in hall to the farthest boarding gate, so that passengers no longer need to ask staff for directions.

The deputy director, who has spoken warmly about the plan at every briefing since March, will be ______ the pilot scheme once it launches, although he has asked to hand it over to a successor after six months.
